Indian student sentenced in US for multimillion-dollar fraud

A US court has sentenced an Indian student, who was in Canada, to four years in prison for a multimillion-dollar fraud scheme. The fraud targeted senior citizens. The student was involved in a scheme that defrauded victims of millions of dollars.
